changelog: FILES 85 + LOADER 3.0.7: aim + gun skins + outfit skins + car skins in one file. Your picked skins are now kept when you re-apply or update the files -- no need to pick them again. The outfit fix stays (your outfit stays on after login), aim works only inside a match while aiming down sights, within the equipped scope's sight range (8x = 300 m), with smooth pro-player motion and no snap. Top-24 outfits and Top-150 gun finishes. Loader 3.0.7 is required; the app update is automatic. Note: a skin's own download must still finish first -- the game blocks auto-download on some networks, and an undownloaded skin cannot render.
